text_original: Collector paraphrase (not verbatim source text): Owner of an E 300 L states the luxurious interior materials are among what they like most. Owner states front seat ventilation costs extra (about 6,700 yuan) and the passenger screen is optional. Owner states the wheel design is weaker than on the previous generation. Owner states rear legroom is limited and the rear bench really only seats two. Owner praises the driver-assistance features. Owner states city fuel consumption is about 12 L/100 km.

Collector paraphrase (not verbatim source text): Owner who bought the E 300 L for business hospitality states they considered Audi and BMW but found them less suited to business use. Owner states the engine is noticeably noisy at idle. Owner states the rear centre tunnel is so high the car is effectively a four-seater. Owner rates value as poor with little discount and hopes for lower prices. Owner states steering is stable and precise and the ride is comfortable on rough roads.

Collector paraphrase (not verbatim source text): Owner states that despite the saying that BMWs are for driving and Mercedes for riding, the E-Class also drives well. Owner states the headlights on the 时尚 trim use a simpler design that looks cheaper and less refined. Owner states the 9-speed automatic shudders slightly in traffic and the mild-hybrid system adds little benefit. Owner states fuel consumption of 12.2 L/100 km is on the high side. Owner states the ambient lighting and wood-and-leather combination make the cabin look upscale. Original excerpt(s), from tool summaries: «其实奔驰开着也不错»

Collector paraphrase (not verbatim source text): Owner of an E 300 L states handling is light and easy and the chassis feels balanced. Owner states a plastic panel on the passenger side creaks on bumpy roads, which hurts the premium feel. Owner states the trunk is very large.

Collector paraphrase (not verbatim source text): Owner of an E 300 L states the luxurious interior and ambient lighting are what they like most. Owner states there was a noticeable new-car odour for about two weeks. Owner states the interior squeaks on unpaved roads, worse in winter. Owner states the trunk is among the best in class.
